metadata.name: Vultima
metadata.description: Vultima IV: Quest of the Avatar - a playable Ultima IV homage in the Commodore 64 palette at 320x200, with the eight virtues, gypsy character creation, towns, shrines, moongates, wireframe dungeons, turn-based combat, and touch controls for iPad and iPhone.

content.bundle: Swipe or tap the map to move. KEYS opens the letters. RETURN confirms.
